correctness.rationale: PASS. Uniform random perfect matchings of 2n ordered endpoints are exactly reproduced by ranking n independent continuous chord pairs. The crossing and nesting indicator kernels have conditional projections p_X=2ℓ(1-ℓ), p_N=ℓ²+2u(1-v). Direct symbolic exact integration with density 2 on 0<u<v<1 independently produced means 1/3, raw second moments 2/15 each and cross moment 1/9, hence first-projection covariance zero, variance 1/45 each. Same-pair X/N indicators are disjoint and disjoint index pairs independent; summing shared-index covariances yields Var=n(n-1)(n+3)/45 and Cov=-n(n-1)/18. Bounded degenerate order-2 Hoeffding remainders have variance O(n²), so n^-3/2 vector CLT has independent N(0,1/45) limits. This is an infinite proof rather than an inference from finite n.
